name: gizza-ai/count-line-frequency
summary: Count and rank how often each line occurs.

tool.description: Count how often each line/value occurs in text and rank them from most to least frequent (like `sort | uniq -c | sort -rn`). Returns each distinct value with its count, plus the number of distinct values and total lines. case_sensitive (default true) and trim (default true) control grouping; blank lines are skipped. Runs locally.

text.description: The text whose lines/values to count (one per line).

case_sensitive.description: When true (default), 'Apple' and 'apple' count separately; false groups them.

trim.description: When true (default), strip surrounding whitespace before counting. Blank lines are always skipped.
